extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath BPMN/process designer with a Send task selected on the canvas. The Properties panel is open on the right, and the task is named “Generate Rejection Email.” In the Implementation section, the task is configured to execute a connector activity using the UiPath GenAI Activities connector, the “GenAI Connection,” and the “Generate Email” activity.
extraction.step_instructions:
Click on the Action dropdown and select “Execute connector activity.”
Click on the Connector dropdown and select “UiPath GenAI Activities.”
In the UiPath GenAI Activities connection field, select “GenAI Connection.”
Click on the Activity dropdown and select “Generate Email.”
Click “Refresh Schema” to load the activity schema for the selected connector activity.
